Analysis.object: From both sports, the emotional distress resulting from missed exercise sessions and the desire to be leaner to improve sports performance were significant predictors.
Further limitations of this study are due to sample characteristics ; the interpretation are limited to aesthetic and ballgames sports.

Larger sample sizes are necessary to test more differentiated models. More comparisons between types of sports are necessary to enhanance the knowledge of the specific risk factors in sports and to understand why prevalence rates for disordered eating vary between different types of sports.

Population.object: Aesthetic sport athletes from two olympic training centers and three elite sport schools, aged between 11 and 17 ; ballgame sports athletes from two elite sport shcools, aged between 12 and 16 years
